# EffortlessFlow

> EffortlessFlow is a tiny software studio (currently just David) building simple, focused apps for everyday problems. The first app, Toby, is in development: a fully offline, chat-driven wishlist and savings companion. No account, no network, your data stays on your device. The studio belief: software should fit into your life, not the other way around.

The website is a single story-driven page that introduces the studio, explains the thinking behind Toby, and invites people to follow the build on social media.
